titleEn: Do I Need Hotel Booking Proof for China Visa-Free Entry?
titleZh: 免签入境中国，一定要准备酒店预订单吗？
summaryEn: Many foreign travellers wonder whether hotel reservations are mandatory when entering China visa-free. This article clarifies official expectations, practical travel tips and what to do if you do not have pre-booked accommodation.
summaryZh: 很多外国游客疑惑免签入境中国是否必须出示酒店订单。本文解读边检实际要求、实操出行建议，以及没有提前订住宿该如何处理。
contentEn:
Is hotel booking legally required for visa-free entry?

According to official Chinese immigration rules, hotel booking is not a legal mandatory document for unilateral, mutual or transit visa-free entry. However, border inspectors retain the right to ask for proof of accommodation during arrival checks.

Practical travel advice

  • Strongly recommended: carry printed or electronic hotel booking confirmations.
  • If you stay with friends or relatives, prepare contact information and residential address of your host.
  • Failure to provide accommodation information may lead to additional questioning at the port of entry, and in rare cases refusal of entry.

Important reminder

Even if you hold valid visa-free eligibility, final entry permission is fully decided by China border-inspection officers at arrival ports.
contentZh:
免签入境中国，酒店订单是法定必备材料吗？

根据中国移民管理公开规定，酒店预订单并不是单方面免签、互免签证、过境免签的法定强制材料。但是口岸边检人员有权在入境查验时要求你出示住宿相关证明。

实操出行建议

  • 强烈建议携带电子版或者纸质酒店预订单备查。
  • 如果住在亲友家中，请准备好接待人的联系电话和居住地址。
  • 无法提供住宿信息，会增加入境问询时间，极少数情况下会被拒绝入境。

重要提醒

即使拥有免签资格，能否入境的最终决定权完全属于口岸中国边检工作人员。

titleEn: Can I Work or Take Internships Under China Visa-Free Policy?
titleZh: 划重点：免签入境中国绝对不能打工和实习
summaryEn: Many international tourists mistakenly believe short-term internships or remote work are allowed under visa-free status. This article explains strict restrictions, penalties and correct application channels for working in China.
summaryZh: 不少外籍游客误以为免签可以短期实习、远程工作。本文说明免签身份的严格限制、违规后果，以及来华工作的正确申请途径。
contentEn:
What activities are strictly prohibited under visa-free entry?

All forms of paid work, internships, remote paid employment, commercial performances are strictly forbidden for visitors entering via unilateral / mutual / transit visa-free schemes.

Consequences of violation

  • Being fined, detained and issued an immigration warning record.
  • Forced deportation and future ban on entering China.
  • Cannot convert visa-free status to work permit inside mainland China.

If you plan to work or intern in China

You need to apply for Z-visa together with official work permit approval documents from overseas before you travel to China.
contentZh:
免签入境哪些行为属于严格禁止？

通过单方面免签、互免签证、过境免签入境的人员，严禁从事任何有偿工作、实习、有偿远程办公、商业演出。

违规会带来什么后果

  • 罚款、拘留，留下出入境不良记录。
  • 被强制遣返，未来限制入境中国。
  • 不能在中国境内直接把免签身份转为工作许可。

如果计划来华工作或者实习

出行前必须在海外提前申请Z类工作签证，并取得官方就业许可文件。

titleEn: 24-Hour Accommodation Registration: Must-do Rule for Foreign Visitors in China
titleZh: 来华外国人24小时住宿登记完整指南
summaryEn: Accommodation registration is a legal obligation for all foreign nationals staying in China. Many travellers ignore this requirement and run into trouble when extending stay or exiting the country. Learn where and how to complete this procedure.
summaryZh: 住宿登记是在华外籍人士法定义务。很多游客忽略该要求，后续出境、办理业务遇到麻烦。本文讲解登记办理地点、操作流程。
contentEn:
Who needs to register?

All foreign citizens entering mainland China (visa-free or visa holders) must finish accommodation registration within 24 hours after arrival.

Two ways of registration

  1. Hotel: most formal hotels will complete registration automatically during your check-in.
  2. Private residence: you must go to local police station with your passport to register in-person.

Risk of missing registration

Lack of accommodation registration record may cause trouble when applying for stay permit or exiting China. Always keep the registration receipt safely.
contentZh:
哪些人需要办理登记？

所有进入中国大陆的外籍人士（无论免签还是持签证入境），入境之后24小时之内必须完成住宿登记。

两种办理方式

  1. 住酒店：正规酒店入住时会代为完成住宿登记。
  2. 住在私人住宅：本人携带护照前往辖区派出所现场办理。

不登记的风险

缺少住宿登记记录，后续申请停留证件、出境时都可能遇到麻烦，请妥善保管登记回执。

titleEn: Calculating China Visa-Free Stay Days: Common Miscalculations to Avoid
titleZh: 免签停留天数怎么算？很多游客算错踩坑
summaryEn: Many travellers mistakenly start counting stay limits from arrival day. China visa-free rules count days starting from midnight of the next calendar day. This article explains calculation logic with real-world examples.
summaryZh: 大量游客错误从入境当天开始算停留期限。中国免签政策从入境次日零时起计算停留时间。本文结合实例讲清楚计算逻辑，避免逾期停留。
contentEn:
Official counting rule

For most China unilateral visa-free entries, stay time begins at 00:00 of the day AFTER your entry date. The arrival day itself does NOT count towards your allowed stay.

Example case

If you enter China on Aug 1st (30-day unilateral visa-free):
Counting starts Aug 2 00:00, latest legal departure date is August 31.

Overstay consequence

Overstaying even for one day will create immigration violation records, fines and impact future travel to China. Always reserve several buffer days for travel delays.
contentZh:
官方计算规则

中国单方面免签政策：停留时间从入境的次日0点开始计算，入境的当天不计入可停留期限。

举个实例

8月1日入境，享受30天单方面免签：
从8月2日0点起算，最晚合法出境日期为8月31日。

逾期停留后果

哪怕逾期停留1天，都会产生出入境违法记录、罚款，影响未来来华。出行建议预留几天缓冲时间应对航班延误。

titleEn: What Happens If My Passport Expires While I Am in China?
titleZh: 在中国境内护照到期/遗失完整处理指南
summaryEn: Losing passport or passport expiring during your China trip is a stressful emergency situation. This article walks you step-by-step: contact embassy, apply emergency travel document, exit procedures for visa-free visitors.
summaryZh: 在中国旅行期间护照过期或者遗失属于紧急情况。本文分步说明联系驻华使领馆、申请紧急旅行证件、免签人员出境流程。
contentEn:
Scenario 1: Passport lost or stolen

  1. Report loss to local police station and obtain loss report.
  2. Contact your home-country embassy / consulate in China for emergency travel document.
  3. With emergency travel paper, complete exit-related formalities before your original visa-free stay expires.

Scenario 2: Passport expires inside China

You cannot extend visa-free status. Must obtain new travel document from your embassy and depart before original permitted stay expires.

Important note

Emergency travel document only supports exit, and cannot grant new visa-free stay rights inside China.
contentZh:
场景一：护照丢失或者被盗

  1. 前往当地派出所报案，拿到报案回执。
  2. 联系本国驻华大使馆或者总领事馆，申请紧急旅行证件。
  3. 在原本免签停留有效期之内，持紧急旅行证件办理出境手续。

场景二：护照在中国境内到期

免签身份不能延期。需要从本国使领馆获取新旅行证件，并且必须在原有免签停留期限内出境。

重要提示

紧急旅行证件仅用于出境，不会重新赋予在中国的免签停留资格。

titleEn: Transit Visa-Free Pitfalls: Mistakes That Get You Rejected at Chinese Airport
titleZh: 240小时过境免签高频踩坑：机场被拒的真实原因
summaryEn: Many travellers misunderstand the 240-hour transit visa-free policy. Holding valid passport is not sufficient. You must have confirmed onward ticket and real transit purpose to third-country/region. This lists most-seen rejection scenarios.
summaryZh: 很多旅客误解240小时过境免签政策。仅有护照并不够，必须要有已确认联程客票、真实前往第三国/地区过境目的。本文列出高频被拒入境场景。
contentEn:
Core requirement for 240-hour transit visa-free

You must transit to a third country or region. Round-trip flight that only fly into-and-out of same origin country does NOT qualify for transit visa-free.

Common rejection reasons

  • No confirmed onward ticket within 240 hours.
  • Plan to only travel inside China without any outbound flight to third-country.
  • Buying separate unconnected flight tickets without confirmed seat booking.

Travel suggestion

Prepare full flight itinerary, show paper / electronic tickets to immigration officers when requested.
contentZh:
240小时过境免签核心硬性条件

你必须是过境前往第三国或者地区。往返只进出同一个出发国的机票，不满足过境免签资格。

高频被拒原因

  • 没有240小时之内已经确认座位的离境联程机票。
  • 只想在中国旅游，没有飞往第三国的出境行程。
  • 分开单独购买多张机票，没有确认的连贯座位预定。

出行建议

准备完整行程单，边检问询时主动出示电子或者纸质机票行程。

titleEn: Can I Extend My Visa-Free Stay Inside Mainland China?
titleZh: 免签入境后可以在中国境内延期停留吗？
summaryEn: A frequently-asked question: many foreigners hope to extend visa-free stay after arriving in China. This article explains policy boundaries, valid emergency scenarios and alternative solutions.
summaryZh: 非常高频问题：不少外国人抵达中国后希望延长免签停留。本文讲清政策边界，哪些紧急情形可以申请，替代出行方案。
contentEn:
General rule

Unilateral, mutual and transit visa-free status cannot be arbitrarily extended. You are supposed to depart before the permitted stay expires.

Exception for emergency

In case of force majeure such as medical emergency, natural disaster, you can submit application to local Exit-Entry Administration Bureau for stay permit document. Approval is not guaranteed and reviewed case-by-case.

Better travel planning advice

If you know you will need longer stay before departure, apply for Chinese visa overseas in advance, do not rely on on-shore extension possibility.
contentZh:
通用规则

单方面免签、互免签证、过境免签身份不能随意办理延期，应当在允许停留期限届满前出境。

仅紧急情形例外

遇到重大疾病、自然灾害等不可抗力，可向当地出入境管理局申请停留证件。但审批为个案审核，不保证一定通过。

更稳妥的出行规划建议

如果出行前就预判需要更长停留时间，请在海外提前申请中国签证，不要寄希望于入境后延期。

titleEn: Tips for Preparing Return / Onward Tickets for China Visa-Free Travel
titleZh: 免签来华往返/联程机票准备避坑要点
summaryEn: Return-ticket requirement confuses many visitors. Is open-jaw ticket acceptable? What about low-cost carrier tickets? What documents are recognised by Chinese border inspection?
summaryZh: 往返机票的要求让很多游客困惑。开口程机票是否认可？廉价航空机票要注意什么？哪些材料会被中国边检接受？
contentEn:
What kind of tickets are accepted?

  • E-ticket confirmation with passenger full name, flight number, exact departure date is acceptable (electronic PDF or print-out).
  • Open-jaw multi-city flights are accepted as long as you show confirmed departure flight out of China.

Low-cost airline warning

Some low-cost carriers only send booking SMS without formal PDF itinerary. Please manually download full official itinerary page before travel.

Important note

Return / onward ticket is mostly a practical recommendation for unilateral & mutual visa-free; it is mandatory requirement for 240-hour transit visa-free.
contentZh:
哪些机票凭证有效？

  • 带有完整乘客姓名、航班号、明确起飞日期的电子客票确认单，PDF电子版或者纸质打印件均可。
  • 开口程多城市机票，只要能展示确认的离开中国出境航班，可以被接受。

廉价航空特别提醒

部分廉价航空只发送短信预定通知，没有正式PDF行程单。出行前请手动下载完整官方行程页面。

重要区分

往返/联程机票对于单方面、互免签证主要属于实操建议；但是240小时过境免签是硬性强制条件。

titleEn: Common Misunderstandings About China Mutual Visa Exemption Agreements
titleZh: 互免签证协定最容易被误解的5个知识点
summaryEn: Many travellers think mutual visa exemption means unlimited stay and any passport works. This article clarifies passport type requirement, 180-day cumulative day-count rule and bilateral treaty restrictions.
summaryZh: 不少游客以为互免签证可以无限停留、任意护照都能用。本文厘清护照类型限制、180天累计停留算法，双边协定约束。
contentEn:
1. Not every passport qualifies

Mutual agreements apply only to ordinary passports. Diplomatic, official passports follow separate rules.

2. 180-day backward rolling cumulative rule

Some bilateral treaties limit cumulative stay within 180-days counted backward from entry date. Even you leave and re-enter, total stay cannot exceed agreed quota.

3. Not equal to permanent residence

Mutual visa exemption only grants short-term entry permission, you cannot apply for long-term residence under this status.
contentZh:
1、不是所有护照都适用

互免协定只针对普通护照；外交、公务护照执行另外一套规则。

2、向后倒推180天累计停留规则

部分双边互免协定执行从入境日向前倒推180天累计停留限制，即使出境再入境，总停留不能超过协定上限。

3、不等于长期居留资格

互免签证只授予短期入境权限，不能凭借互免身份申请长期居留。

titleEn: Pre-departure Checklist Before You Travel to China Visa-Free
titleZh: 免签来华出行前自查清单｜出发前逐项核对
summaryEn: Handy pre-departure checklist for foreigners travelling to China visa-free: passport validity, documents to prepare, activities you must avoid, buffer-time planning before expiry.
summaryZh: 面向免签来华外籍旅客实用出发自查清单：护照有效期、备查材料、禁止行为、预留到期缓冲时间。
contentEn:
✅ Passport check

  • Passport validity ≥6 months (transit visa-free minimum ≥3 months).
  • Enough blank visa pages inside passport.

✅ Documents recommended to prepare

  • Return / onward flight itinerary.
  • Hotel booking or host contact information.
  • Sufficient funds proof (bank statement is optional but recommended).

❌ Activities you cannot do under visa-free

No paid-work, internship, formal study, journalist reporting, commercial performance.

✅ Time buffer

Do not plan your flight exactly on last allowed departure day; reserve 2-3 days buffer for flight delays.
contentZh:
✅ 护照自查

  • 护照有效期不少于6个月（过境免签最少3个月）。
  • 护照内留有足够空白签证页。

✅ 建议随身携带备查材料

  • 往返或者联程机票行程单。
  • 酒店订单或者接待人联系方式。
  • 资金证明（银行流水非强制但建议准备）。

❌ 免签身份禁止行为

禁止有偿工作、实习、正式留学、记者采访、商业演出。

✅ 时间预留缓冲

不要把返程航班刚好卡到允许出境的最后一天，为航班延误预留2-3天缓冲。

titleEn: Essential Mobile Apps for Foreign Travellers Visiting China
titleZh: 外国人来华必备手机APP完整清单
summaryEn: If you travel in China, certain mobile applications will make your trip much easier. This article covers payment, transport, translation and map apps for foreign visitors.
summaryZh: 在中国旅行，部分手机APP会极大方便你的出行。本文面向外国游客介绍支付、交通、翻译、地图类软件使用要点。
contentEn:
Maps & Navigation

Amap and Baidu Maps are widely used inside mainland China. Google Maps has limited functionality behind firewall. Download offline map packages before visiting remote areas.

Translation tools

DeepL, iFlytek translation app support real-time voice translation for street conversations and restaurant ordering.

Transport & taxi

Didi is the main ride-hailing platform. International credit card can be bound inside app for overseas users.

Important note

Some apps require mainland phone number registration. Prepare eSIM or local SIM card after arrival.
contentZh:
地图导航

高德、百度地图在中国大陆使用最稳定；谷歌地图功能受限。去偏远地区建议提前下载离线地图包。

翻译工具

DeepL、讯飞翻译支持实时语音翻译，逛街、点餐场景非常实用。

打车交通

滴滴出行是主流网约车平台，海外用户可以绑定境外信用卡。

重要提示

部分APP需要中国大陆手机号注册，抵达后建议办理eSIM或者本地电话卡。

titleEn: How to Get Mobile Internet in China: SIM Card, eSIM and Roaming Tips
titleZh: 来华如何解决手机网络：SIM卡、eSIM、国际漫游对比
summaryEn: Stable mobile internet is critical for overseas tourists. Compare physical SIM, eSIM and international roaming pros and cons before travelling to China.
summaryZh: 稳定手机网络对外国游客至关重要。出行前对比实体SIM卡、eSIM、国际漫游各自优缺点。
contentEn:
Option 1: International roaming

Simple activation without changing SIM, but data cost is usually expensive. Not recommended for long-stay visitors.

Option 2: Physical local SIM card

Buy at airport arrival hall, affordable price. Requires unlocked phone and passport for real-name registration.

Option3: eSIM

Most convenient for modern smartphones, purchase online before departure. No physical card swap needed.

Reminder

Global social media platforms may need VPN services, which are not permitted inside mainland China.
contentZh:
方案1：国际漫游

无需换卡，激活简单，但流量资费通常很贵，不适合长期停留。

方案2：本地实体SIM卡

抵达机场大厅可以购买，价格实惠。手机需要无锁，凭护照实名登记。

方案3：eSIM虚拟卡

现代手机最方便方案，可以出行前线上购买，不需要更换实体卡片。

提醒

境外社交软件在中国大陆境内需要VPN，而VPN在国内属于不允许私自使用。

titleEn: Cash vs Mobile Payment: How Foreign Tourists Pay inside China
titleZh: 现金与移动支付，外国游客在中国如何付款
summaryEn: Most shops in China prefer mobile QR-code payment. Foreign tourists often face payment difficulties. This article explains cash usage, foreign card support and tourist-oriented payment solutions.
summaryZh: 中国绝大多数商户优先二维码移动支付。外国游客经常遇到付款难题。本文讲解现金使用、境外信用卡支持、面向游客的支付方案。
contentEn:
Carry small-amount cash

Some small street-side shops, old-style taxis may not support card payment. Keep small RMB cash notes handy.

Credit card acceptance

Major shopping malls, international brand hotels support Visa / Mastercard. Small local restaurants and street vendors usually do not accept foreign bank cards.

Tourist digital payment solution

Alipay Tour Card and WeChat Tourist Wallet allow overseas visitors to use QR payment without local bank account.

Practical advice

Exchange small amount of Chinese Yuan cash upon airport arrival for emergency scenarios.
contentZh:
随身携带小额现金

部分街边小店、老式出租车不支持刷卡。常备小额人民币纸币。

信用卡受理范围

大型商场、国际品牌酒店支持Visa/Mastercard。本地小餐馆、路边摊贩大多不支持境外银行卡。

游客数字支付方案

支付宝境外游客版、微信游客钱包可以让海外游客无需内地银行卡使用二维码付款。

实操建议

抵达机场兑换少量人民币现金，用于应急场景。

titleEn: Simple Chinese Dining Etiquette Foreign Travellers Should Know
titleZh: 外国游客需要了解的中国餐桌礼仪小常识
summaryEn: Basic dining customs will help you avoid awkward moments during meals in China. Learn chopstick usage, toasting and tipping culture.
summaryZh: 简单了解餐桌风俗，可以帮你在中国吃饭避免尴尬。学习筷子用法、敬酒习惯、小费文化。
contentEn:
Chopstick manners

Do not stick chopsticks vertically upright into rice bowl, this resembles funeral ritual customs.

Tipping culture

Tipping is NOT common practice across mainland China. You do not need to leave extra money for restaurant waiters or taxi drivers.

Sharing-dishes culture

Most Chinese restaurants serve shared dishes for whole table. Public serving chopsticks are often provided.

Toasting

At banquets people may propose toasts. You can politely decline alcohol drinks with soft refusal.
contentZh:
筷子礼仪

不要把筷子竖直插在米饭碗中，这是丧葬相关习俗，属于忌讳。

小费文化

中国大陆没有小费习惯，餐厅、出租车不需要额外支付小费。

合餐文化

中餐大多一桌人共享菜品，很多餐厅会提供公筷公勺。

敬酒习俗

宴席场合会有敬酒，你可以礼貌委婉拒绝饮酒。

titleEn: Public Transport Tips: Subway & High-Speed Rail for Foreign Tourists
titleZh: 外国游客乘坐中国地铁与高铁出行完整提示
summaryEn: China high-speed rail and metro systems are very convenient. This article covers ticket purchase, ID check, luggage rules and common travel tips for overseas visitors.
summaryZh: 中国高铁与地铁系统出行十分便利。本文讲解购票、证件核验、行李规定以及外国游客出行实用提示。
contentEn:
High-speed rail ticket

Trains require real-name ID check. You can use passport to buy tickets at station ticket counter. Some third-party platforms support foreign passport booking.

Luggage restrictions

Each passenger has weight & size limit for carry-on luggage on high-speed trains.

City subway

Most city metro support QR-code ride, but foreign passport registration may be required for tourist transport code.

Arrive early

High-speed railway stations are usually huge, arrive at least 30 minutes before departure time.
contentZh:
高铁车票

高铁实行实名核验，可以在车站人工窗口凭护照购票。部分第三方平台支持护照订票。

行李限制

高铁随身行李有重量和尺寸限制。

城市地铁

多数城市地铁支持二维码乘车，游客乘车码可能需要护照实名。

提前到站

高铁站建筑普遍很大，建议至少发车前30分钟抵达车站。

titleEn: Common Tourist Scams in China and How Foreign Visitors Can Avoid Them
titleZh: 来华游客常见骗局以及如何规避
summaryEn: Most tourist destinations are safe, but a small number of scam cases exist. Learn typical traps for foreign travellers and how to respond properly.
summaryZh: 绝大多数旅游目的地治安良好，但仍然存在少量骗局。了解专门针对外国游客的典型陷阱以及正确应对方式。
contentEn:
Typical tourist traps

  • Art gallery / tea-house persuasion: strangers invite you for tea or art appreciation and overcharge afterwards.
  • Overcharging unlicensed taxi drivers near scenic spots.

Safety advice

  • Decline invitations from unknown strangers firmly and politely.
  • Use official Didi taxi instead of unlicensed private cars.
  • Keep hotel emergency contact and local police number 110 in your phone contacts.
contentZh:
典型旅游陷阱

  • 茶馆/画廊骗局：陌生人搭讪邀请喝茶看画展，之后高额收费。
  • 景区周边黑车司机漫天要价。

安全建议

  • 遇到陌生人搭讪邀请，礼貌坚决拒绝。
  • 优先使用官方滴滴平台，不要乘坐黑车。
  • 手机保存酒店紧急联系，报警号码110。

titleEn: Medical Guide for Foreign Tourists: Getting Sick During Travel in China
titleZh: 外国游客就医指南：在中国旅行生病怎么办
summaryEn: What should you do when you fall ill while travelling in China? This article covers international hospitals, public hospital procedure and travel medical insurance tips.
summaryZh: 在中国旅行期间生病该如何处理？本文介绍涉外医院、公立医院就诊流程、旅行医疗保险提示。
contentEn:
Two types of medical institutions

Public general hospitals provide full-range medical service. International clinics have English-speaking staff with relatively higher price.

Travel medical insurance

Strongly recommend purchasing travel insurance covering medical expense before departure. Many visa-free travellers ignore medical insurance preparation.

Important reminder

Keep your passport handy for registration when visiting hospital. Save receipts for insurance claim reimbursement.
contentZh:
两类医疗机构

公立综合医院科室齐全；涉外国际诊所配备英语工作人员，但价格更高。

旅行医疗保险

强烈建议出行前购买覆盖医疗费用的旅行保险，很多免签游客忽略保险准备。

重要提醒

就医登记需要携带护照，妥善保存票据用于保险理赔。

titleEn: Shopping & Souvenir Tips for Foreign Visitors Traveling in China
titleZh: 外国游客在中国购物买伴手礼实用提示
summaryEn: Advice for buying souvenirs, handicrafts and local goods in China. Understand price bargaining and customs export restrictions.
summaryZh: 在中国购买纪念品、手工艺品的建议，了解砍价习惯以及出境海关限制。
contentEn:
Bargaining

Open-air local markets usually allow price bargaining. Fixed-price shopping malls and brand stores do not accept negotiation.

Customs export limits

Some cultural relics, special protected wildlife products cannot be taken out of China. Do not buy unknown antique goods from street vendors.

Receipt preservation

Keep shopping receipts, especially for expensive handicraft goods.
contentZh:
砍价习惯

露天集市一般可以砍价；商场品牌明码标价店铺不议价。

海关出境限制

部分文物、保护野生物制品禁止携带出境。不要在路边摊贩购买来历不明古董。

票据保存

贵重手工艺品请保留购物小票。

titleEn: Weather & Clothing Preparation for Traveling Across Different Regions of China
titleZh: 中国不同地区旅行天气与衣物准备建议
summaryEn: China has huge geographic climate differences. Same travel date may mean hot summer in south and cold autumn in northern areas.
summaryZh: 中国国土辽阔气候差异巨大。同一时间段南方盛夏、北方已经入秋，出行衣物需要提前规划。
contentEn:
South China

South-east China is humid and hot in summer, heavy rain typhoon season from June-September.

North China

Beijing, northern plains have big day-night temperature gap in autumn. Winter can drop far below zero degree.

Western plateau

Tibet and Qinghai plateau: strong sun ultraviolet radiation, bring sun-protection equipment even in summer.

Practical tip

Check multi-day local weather forecast before you travel to each new city.
contentZh:
华南地区

中国东南部夏季湿热，6-9月台风多雨。

华北地区

北京等北方平原秋季昼夜温差巨大，冬季气温会跌至零下。

西部高原

西藏青海高原紫外线极强，即使夏天也要准备防晒装备。

实操建议

每到一座城市，提前查看当地多日天气预报。

titleEn: Photography Rules for Foreign Travellers in China: What You Can and Cannot Shoot
titleZh: 外国游客在中国拍照：哪些可以拍、哪些严禁拍摄
summaryEn: General tourist photography is fine, but certain locations are prohibited for photographing. Learn where you should not take photos during your trip.
summaryZh: 普通旅游拍照没问题，但部分场所严禁拍照。旅行途中分清禁止拍摄地点，避免不必要麻烦。
contentEn:
Places no-photo allowed

  • Military facilities, military bases, military-related airports.
  • Some museum cultural relic exhibition halls mark no-photography signs.
  • Government restricted security-sensitive installations.

Ordinary tourist-attraction

Normal scenic spots, city street, historical monuments are okay for photography.

Respect individual portrait rights

Do not take close-up photos of local strangers without permission.
contentZh:
禁止拍照地点

  • 军事设施、军事基地、军用相关机场。
  • 部分博物馆文物展厅会张贴禁止拍照标识。
  • 政府敏感安保设施。

普通旅游景点

常规景区、城市街道、历史古迹都可以正常拍照。

尊重肖像权

未经许可不要近距离拍摄陌生人特写。

titleEn: Customs Declaration Guide: What Items Need to Declare When Entering China
titleZh: 入境中国海关申报指南：哪些物品必须申报
summaryEn: Many tourists ignore customs declaration rules and get goods detained. Understand cash limits, food, animal-plant products and prohibited import items.
summaryZh: 很多游客忽略海关申报规则，物品被扣留。了解现金限额、食品、动植物制品以及禁止入境物品清单。
contentEn:
Cash declaration

Carrying cash over 5000 US-dollar equivalent currency must make customs declaration upon arrival.

Food & plant products

Fresh fruits, raw meat, dairy products are generally prohibited import items to prevent animal-plant disease spread.

Other prohibited items

Dangerous drugs, dangerous weapons, obscene publications are strictly forbidden.

Tip

When you are unsure about your belongings, fill in customs declaration form on arrival.
contentZh:
现金申报

携带等值5000美元以上现金入境必须向海关申报。

食品动植物

新鲜水果、生肉、乳制品大多禁止入境，防范动植物疫病传入。

其他违禁品

毒品、危险武器、淫秽出版物严禁带入境内。

小提示

拿不准随身物品是否合规，抵达时主动填写海关申报单。

titleEn: Travel Insurance Suggestions for Visa-Free Visitors Coming to China
titleZh: 免签来华游客旅行保险选购建议
summaryEn: China visa-free entry does NOT require mandatory travel insurance. But buying proper travel insurance is strongly recommended for overseas visitors.
summaryZh: 中国免签入境不强制购买旅行保险。但仍然强烈建议外籍游客配置合适旅行保险。
contentEn:
Is insurance mandatory?

For unilateral, mutual and transit visa-free entry, travel insurance is not mandatory document for border-inspection.

Why you still need insurance

Local medical service for foreign visitors can be expensive. Good travel insurance covers medical treatment, emergency evacuation, trip interruption compensation.

What to look for in policy

Double-check policy territory covers mainland China, exclude Hong Kong Macau if not needed. Check medical expense coverage amount.
contentZh:
保险是强制要求吗？

单方面免签、互免签证、过境免签入境，旅行保险不属于边检强制查验材料。

为什么仍然建议购买保险

外籍人员在国内就医费用较高。合格旅行保险覆盖医疗救治、紧急救援、行程中断赔偿。

选购保险注意点

确认保障地域包含中国大陆；按需区分是否包含港澳地区；重点看医疗保额。

titleEn: Short-term Apartment Rental Rules for Foreign Visitors in China
titleZh: 外国游客在中国短租民宿公寓注意事项
summaryEn: Booking short-term apartment rentals is popular among foreign travellers. Special accommodation registration rules apply for foreigners staying in private rental apartments.
summaryZh: 短租民宿公寓很受外国游客欢迎。外国人入住私人公寓住宿登记有特殊规则。
contentEn:
Important legal obligation

When you stay in private short-term apartment (not formal hotel), the host or yourself must complete foreigner accommodation registration within 24 hours at local police station.

Rental platform reminder

Some short-term rental hosts are unfamiliar with foreign-visitor registration rules. Communicate registration requirement before confirming booking.

Risk warning

Some private apartments cannot accept foreign passport holders. Confirm foreign-guest eligibility before paying deposit.
contentZh:
法定义务提醒

入住非酒店私人短租公寓，房东或者本人必须24小时之内到辖区派出所完成外国人住宿登记。

预订平台提示

部分民宿房东不熟悉外籍人员登记规则，下单前提前沟通登记事宜。

风险提醒

部分私人公寓不接待外籍护照持有人，付定金之前确认可以接待外国人。

titleEn: Chinese Airport Security Check Tips for Foreign Air Passengers
titleZh: 外国旅客国内机场安检、乘机实用提示
summaryEn: Airport security screening rules inside mainland China have some differences compared with many other countries. Prepare your luggage in advance for smooth security check.
summaryZh: 中国大陆机场安检规则和部分海外国家存在差异。提前整理行李，让安检流程更加顺畅。
contentEn:
Liquid rule

Carry-on liquid containers volume limit 100 ml each. Large liquid bottles need to go into checked baggage.

Identity document

For domestic flights inside China, foreign visitors must present physical passport document, digital copy is generally not accepted.

Prohibited carry-on items

Many kinds of power-bank must be carried-on, cannot be put inside checked luggage.
contentZh:
液态物品规定

随身单瓶液体容器容积不超过100毫升，大瓶液体必须托运。

乘机证件

外国人乘坐国内航班，需要出示实体护照原件，一般不接受照片复印件。

充电宝

充电宝必须随身携带，不允许放入托运行李箱。

titleEn: Chinese Public Holiday Travel Warning: Crowd, Ticket & Hotel Price Surge
titleZh: 中国法定节假日出行提醒：人流、车票、酒店涨价
summaryEn: During Chinese major public holidays, tourist attractions, high-speed rail tickets and hotel prices change dramatically. Foreign visitors should plan trips avoiding peak dates if possible.
summaryZh: 中国重大法定节假日期间景区、高铁车票、酒店价格会发生剧烈变化。外国游客尽量避开高峰日期出行。
contentEn:
Main busy holiday periods

Spring Festival, May Day Labour holiday, National Day (Oct 1-7) are three largest domestic travel rush windows.

Practical impact

  • High-speed rail tickets sell-out very quickly.
  • Hotel room price multiply two-three times higher than normal day.
  • Famous scenic spots are extremely crowded.

Suggestion

If you must travel during holiday period, book train tickets and hotel several weeks ahead of time.
contentZh:
主要高峰节假日

春节、五一劳动节、十一国庆节是国内三大旅游高峰。

实际出行影响

  • 高铁车票短时间售罄。
  • 酒店价格相比平日上涨2-3倍。
  • 知名景区游客爆满。

出行建议

如果必须节假日出行，提前数周预定车票与酒店。

titleEn: Detailed Consequences of Overstaying Your Visa-Free Period in China
titleZh: 免签在中国逾期停留完整后果说明
summaryEn: Overstay is a serious immigration violation. This article lists fines, records, deportation and future entry restrictions for foreign visitors who overstay visa-free duration.
summaryZh: 逾期停留属于严重出入境违法行为。本文完整说明罚款、记录、遣返、未来入境限制。
contentEn:
Short-term slight overstay

Short overstay may result in fine according to days overstayed, and create immigration violation record inside system.

Long-time overstay

Long-term illegal stay can lead to detention, deportation and entry ban for certain number of years.

Important advice

Always keep buffer days for flight delay. If you already overstay, actively contact local exit-entry bureau instead of hiding.
contentZh:
短期轻微逾期

短期逾期会按照逾期天数处以罚款，同时系统留存出入境违法记录。

长期非法滞留

长时间非法滞留会拘留、遣送出境，并且施加年限不等的入境限制。

重要建议

出行预留航班延误缓冲天数；一旦已经发生逾期，主动联系出入境管理局，不要躲藏。

titleEn: Minor / Children Entry Rules Under China Visa-Free Policy
titleZh: 未成年人儿童免签入境中国相关规则
summaryEn: Children and minors also follow visa-free rules, but special requirements apply when travelling without both parents. Read entry rules for under-age foreign visitors.
summaryZh: 儿童未成年人同样适用免签政策，但父母不全陪同入境时有特殊要求。阅读未成年外籍游客入境规则。
contentEn:
Children eligibility

Minors holding eligible country ordinary passport enjoy same visa-free policy as adults.

Travelling without both parents

When minor travels with only one parent or third-party guardian, border-inspection may ask for guardian-consent related documents.

Passport requirement

Child independent passport is required. Child cannot be recorded inside parent’s old-style passport for entry.
contentZh:
儿童资格

持有符合条件国家普通护照的未成年人，和成年人享受同等免签政策。

父母不全陪同出行

未成年人仅跟随一方家长或者第三方监护人出行，边检有可能要求出示监护同意相关材料。

护照要求

儿童需要独立护照，不能使用旧版依附在父母护照上的登记方式入境。

titleEn: Physical & Mental Health Tips for Long-Distance Overseas Travel to China
titleZh: 长途来华旅行身心健康注意事项
summaryEn: Long-haul flights and cross-culture travel bring physical tiredness. Learn jet-lag adjustment, food adaptation and mental stress relief tips for overseas tourists.
summaryZh: 长途航班和跨文化旅行会带来身体疲惫。了解时差调整、饮食适应、缓解旅行压力小技巧。
contentEn:
Jet-lag adjustment

Adjust sleep schedule gradually before departure. Drink enough water during long-haul flight, reduce alcohol intake on airplane.

Food adaptation

Chinese food flavour varies widely across regions. If you have special food allergy, prepare translation card showing allergy information.

Mental stress

Culture shock is normal. Schedule slow-paced rest days inside your travel itinerary.
contentZh:
时差调整

出发前逐步调整作息；长途航班多喝水，少饮用机上酒精饮品。

饮食适应

中国各地口味差异巨大。如果你有食物过敏，准备好写有过敏信息翻译卡片。

心理适应

文化冲击属于正常现象，行程规划中预留节奏舒缓的休息日。

titleEn: Important Note: Visa Rules Difference between Mainland China, Hong Kong and Macau
titleZh: 重要提示：中国大陆、香港、澳门签证免签规则互相独立
summaryEn: Many travellers make huge mistake: visa-free for Hong Kong / Macau does NOT automatically grant visa-free entry into mainland China. Separate immigration rules apply.
summaryZh: 大量游客踩坑：香港澳门免签不等于中国大陆免签，三地出入境规则相互独立。
contentEn:
Key separation rule

Mainland China, Hong Kong SAR and Macau SAR implement independent immigration systems. Visa-free eligibility for Hong Kong does NOT give you right to enter mainland China.

Cross-border flow

If you fly into Hong Kong and then travel onward to mainland China, you need to satisfy mainland entry policy (visa-free or visa).

Document reminder

When you travel between mainland and HK/Macau you will go through immigration border check, passport stamp will be issued.
contentZh:
核心独立规则

中国大陆、香港特别行政区、澳门特别行政区执行三套独立出入境体系。香港免签不等于可以直接进入内地。

跨境行程

飞抵香港之后再前往中国大陆，必须满足内地入境政策（免签或者签证）。

证件提示

内地和港澳之间往返会经过边检，护照会加盖出入境印章。
